name: Expenses Report
query:
select 
name as 'Bill No:Link/Collection Log:180',
serial as 'Serial:Link/Residence:180',
       area as 'Area:Data:180',
       '' as 'Tenant Name:Data:180',
       date_of_expense as 'Paid Date:Date:180',
       '' as 'Month:Data:100',
       comments as 'Description:Data:180',
       -amount as 'Expense Amount:Currency:180'
from tabExpense where date_of_expense between  %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s
